claims.description: API keys are configured in environment
claims.expectedEvidence: GLM_API_KEY and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variables exist and are non-empty

claims.description: System-wide symlink to shark CLI exists
claims.verificationMethod: fs.lstatSync to verify symlink, fs.readlink to verify target

claims.description: Surgical debug protocol triggers on tool failure escalation
claims.expectedEvidence: DebugInjector.injectDebugger() is called when stagnation alert type is 'escalation'
claims.verificationMethod: Mock DebugInjector and verify method call

claims.description: Nemotron service event bus is operational
claims.expectedEvidence: Event can be published and received by subscriber
claims.verificationMethod: Create event bus, subscribe, publish, verify receipt

claims.description: Nemotron message classifier correctly sizes messages
claims.expectedEvidence: Messages classified as 2k/4k/6k/8k based on token count
claims.verificationMethod: Test classifier with various message sizes

claims.description: Shark CLI detects micro mode correctly
claims.expectedEvidence: shark --micro outputs 'Mode: Micro' and generates micro config
claims.verificationMethod: Execute shark script with --micro flag, parse output

claims.description: Shark CLI detects macro mode correctly
claims.expectedEvidence: shark --macro outputs 'Mode: Macro' and generates macro config
claims.verificationMethod: Execute shark script with --macro flag, parse output

claims.description: Shark CLI detects direct mode correctly
claims.expectedEvidence: shark --direct outputs 'Mode: Direct' and launches standard OpenCode
claims.verificationMethod: Execute shark script with --direct flag, parse output

claims.description: Fragment files exist and contain valid instructions
claims.expectedEvidence: 4 fragment files exist with non-empty content containing agent instructions
claims.verificationMethod: Read each fragment file, verify content structure

claims.expectedEvidence: opencode.json contains 0-opencode-zen provider with free models
claims.verificationMethod: Parse opencode.json, verify provider exists with correct models

claims.expectedEvidence: AutoDebugEngine can be instantiated and has getDebugInjector method
claims.verificationMethod: Import and instantiate AutoDebugEngine, verify method exists

claims.expectedEvidence: shark --micro launches successfully and loads Shark Agent fragment
claims.verificationMethod: Execute shark --micro with simple task, verify output contains expected markers

stage1.description: Docker sandbox tests - isolated unit tests

stage2.description: Local device tests - integration tests requiring local environment

functional.criteria: All test functions return true, exit code 0

intent.criteria: All claims have corresponding tests, all planned features implemented

security.criteria: No modifications to SYSTEM or PERSONAL zones, no secrets in code
